name: Information Wallpaper Overlay
author: Adrian Wild
description: Information on your wallpaper: up to six tiles behind your windows, laid out the way Hyprland tiles windows. GitHub repos with a year of commits and live Actions runs; herdr's coding agents, working or waiting for you; builds, flashing and updates, passed or failed; what's playing; or any installed plugin's menu, shown live. Follows your theme, gaps and rounding, never takes a click, uses your gh login, and can fill the lock screen too.

barWidget.description: CI status, and the settings for the information tiles on the desktop.
